scope_summary: Internal consistency and labelling of the historical dataset (data.js, analysis.js, narrative.js, the parts of appearance.js the dossier quotes) and of what app.js shows from it (leaf rule and totals, plateau and centre-separation readings, card/dossier rows and pills, event dossier and labels, Command tab, OOB list, counters, facing, overlays), on the audited build f10fe585 (origin/main 43e3e5b). Method: node scripts in an isolated copy (history-iso) loading the world module, the five data files and the generated helpers as sim-test.js does, plus functions extracted from the live app.js by name; archived builds read for history. Scripts: /home/user/Austerlitz/tools/audit-post8/history/*.js; outputs and README: /home/user/Austerlitz/docs/audit-post8-evidence/history/. Verified sound: no total double-counts (leaf rule; Santon now Suchet's child, D-3 fixed), references 0 errors, tour stop 4 figures, notes' arithmetic, prior fixes H-1/H-2/H-3/H-4/H-12/H-13/H-14/H-18/D-3/D-4/S-5, the 8K register's grades as shown, halted formations' facing. Main problems: (1) the Russian Guard, Liechtenstein and Miloradovich drawn walking away from the enemy for 40-85 min under "Counter-attacking"/"Charging"; (2) NEW in 8J: Legrand's division marker walks through the Sokolnitz castle and the III Column holding it (37 m at 08:51); (3) the face-about event shows "Fact"/"Attested in the standard accounts" beside its own why claimed "This map's reading"; (4) the Russian Guard's A-graded approach contradicts the project's own A-graded readings (disposition: behind Blasowitz and Kruh; Stutterheim: onto the Blasowitz-Krug heights, Blasowitz garrisoned) and no Allied formation is within 1.4 km of Blasowitz when the event says the French take it from the Guard; (5) 44 of 88 A grades carried forward from earlier anchors, against the rule 8K applied to Suchet; plus a set of S3/S4 text-position, labelling and record inconsistencies. No source tracing (other agents), no browser.

Displayed (not summed) overlaps remain: Langeron's counter 11,700 includes Kamensky's 4,250 drawn separately from 08:00 (no note says so); Buxhowden's HQ shows 40,000. findings.title: Russian Guard, Liechtenstein and Miloradovich drawn walking away from the enemy while shown Counter-attacking/Charging
findings.subsystem: simulation: leg timing and status/heading presentation
findings.user_impact: In 'The Guard' phase (a theme, the dwell's events, the eagle) the Russian Guard reaches its attack place at 11:15 and at once walks east, facing east, for 85 minutes with the pills 'Counter-attacking'/'Charging', never meeting the French Guard; the phase-6 arrow draws a westward attack over the eastward movement. The gait (8E) animates the walk (1.5-1.8 km/h).
findings.evidence: motion-vs-status.txt: rg_inf 'counterattack' moving away 11:20-12:40 at 1.48 km/h, 160 deg off the bearing to Vandamme; rg_cav 'charging' moving away 11:20-12:40 at 1.79 km/h; lich 'charging' moving away 10:35-11:10; milo 'counterattack' moving away 09:50-11:05; kollo 'counterattack' at 4.86 km/h 10:20-10:25. guard-attack-motion.txt: rg_inf [327,194] at 11:15 to [393,196] at 12:40, heading 88 deg (east); status 'counterattack' until 12:45. OVERLAYS phase 6 'Russian Imperial Guard' attack arrow [[413,202],[359,187],[330,192]].
findings.expected: While a formation's status is offensive, it is not drawn moving away from its opponent; or the status and heading shown during a leg match the leg (e.g. the destination's status, or a hold before the retreat).
findings.observed: anchorList's default (an undated leg runs from the previous anchor's arrival to the next phase start) starts the retreat leg the moment the attack anchor is reached; stateAt shows the phase's status; the poser faces the heading. waitingFor (decision 46) handles only dated departures.
findings.remedy: Owner decision (decision 45 keeps undated legs spread over their interval): either a presentation rule (while a leg moves away from the nearest enemy, show the destination anchor's status and keep facing the enemy), or a data task adding holds (moveMin) on rg_inf@7, rg_cav@7, lich@6, milo@6 with the timing basis recorded; add a motion-vs-status check to sim-test.js.
findings.repro: node tools/audit-post8/history/motion-vs-status.js; node tools/audit-post8/history/probes.js guard-attack-motion (ISO=isolated copy). In the page: 11:30-12:40, select the Russian Guard.
findings.cause_hypothesis: Phase-granular status plus the default leg window.
findings.cause_verified: yes (anchorList/legWindow read; positions and headings computed)
findings.risk: Changing leg timing moves chronology verdicts and motion-block baselines; a presentation rule is lower risk.
findings.validation: Re-run motion-vs-status.js: zero offensive-status samples moving away; check:chronology unchanged.

findings.title: New in 8J: Legrand's division marker walks through the Sokolnitz castle and the III Column holding it
findings.user_impact: 08:30-09:10 the French division that the act says 'Fights for Sokolnitz village and the castle wall' is drawn passing over the castle (25 m at 08:45) and through the Allied III Column storming it (37 m at 08:51): two opposing blocks stand in one another at the opening's 08:45 moment.
findings.evidence: legrand-through-castle.txt (probes.js): legrand [213.0,343.5] at 08:45, 25 m from LANDMARK_SITES.castle; 37 m from prz at 08:51 (closest.js); status 'engaged' throughout. Archive diff: Legrand's anchors identical in 8H, 8J and now; prz@2/@4/@7 moved by 8J from [238,332]/[233,344]/[227,338] to [215,341]; before 8J the leg passed about 0.67 km from the III Column. 8J's consequences (CHANGELOG 8J entry) measured knowledge, plateau and chronology, not proximity.
findings.expected: Opposing formations' interpolated legs do not pass through each other except in a recorded melee; a data task's consequences include its neighbours' legs.
findings.observed: Legrand's single-division marker moves 08:00-09:30 from Sokolnitz [206,366] straight to [220,321] (to represent Levasseur's brigade marching up), crossing the III Column's new place.
findings.remedy: Data task: route legrand@4 with a via west of the castle and pheasantry, or hold the division at Sokolnitz (only Levasseur's brigade moved, per its own act); add an opposing-proximity check (sim-test.js or audit.js) and run it in every data task.
findings.effort: 2-6 h (data task protocol, check:data reference, motion baselines re-measured)
findings.cause_hypothesis: 8J re-plotted prz onto the castle site without checking neighbouring legs.
findings.risk: Moves the motion block's visibility baselines (owner rule for geographic baselines).
findings.validation: closest.js shows legrand x prz above 0.5 km; check:chronology unchanged.

findings.title: The face-about event is labelled Fact ('Attested in the standard accounts') beside its own why claimed 'This map's reading'
findings.subsystem: data/presentation: event claim (analysis.js EVENTS) and dossierEvent
findings.user_impact: The event dossier for 'Kutuzov orders the 4th Column to face about' (09:15; a moment of the Pratzen theme) shows the pill 'Fact' and the footer 'Attested in the standard accounts of the battle.' while the same dossier's why says the order is this map's reading and narrative.js notes 'No account read has Kutuzov order the 4th Column to face about'. The map label and caption carry no qualifier (evNote has none for 'fact').
findings.evidence: event-claims.txt: face-about pill:fact, why:interpretation. dossierEvent renders claimPill(e.claim) and CLAIM[e.claim].note; claimTag after the why renders CLAIM_WORDS.interpretation ('This map's reading'). Decision 201 (b) labelled the why and the phase line but did not change the pill (CHANGELOG step 4b, finding (2)).
findings.expected: The event's claim matches what the project's evidence supports: CLAIM.recon ('Reconstruction: Inferred from the narrative'), which also adds 'reconstruction' to its label via evNote.
findings.remedy: Data task: EVENTS[#face-about].claim 'recon' (one word); measure the label change in check:visual; consider a test.js rule that an event's pill is not fact/est when its own why is claimed interpretation or uncertain.
findings.repro: node tools/audit-post8/history/event-claims.js; in the page, press the 09:15 marker.
findings.cause_hypothesis: Decision 201 (b) addressed hours and whys, not the pill.
findings.risk: Label length may move a drop limit at 09:15 views.
findings.validation: event-claims.js flags nothing; check:visual within limits.

findings.title: The Russian Guard's A-graded approach contradicts the project's own A-graded readings; nobody holds Blasowitz when it falls 'from the Russian Guard'
findings.subsystem: data: rg_inf/rg_cav tracks, PLANS.al reserve column, ANALYSIS plan, EVENTS blasowitz
findings.user_impact: The Guard is drawn at Krzenowitz from 04:00 (A) and creeping to [378,196] by 10:30 (A carried), then straight onto Stare Vinohrady; it never stands on the heights by Blasowitz and Krug or in Blasowitz. At 11:15 the event 'The French take Blasowitz from the Russian Guard' fires with no Allied formation within 1.4 km (Guard infantry 1.78 km). The plan tab and the plan theme say the Guard was to remain 'behind Krzenowitz'.
findings.evidence: blasowitz-guard.txt (probes.js): at 11:15 rg_inf 1.78 km, rg_cav 1.54 km, lich 1.43 km from Blasowitz. Register C6.21 (A, fact): the disposition 'besetzt bei Tages-Anbruche die Position hinter Blasowitz und Kruh'. C6.c6 (A): Stutterheim has the Guard leave the heights before Austerlitz at the appointed hour 'auf die Anhöhen bey Blasowitz und Krug', engage Rivaud's skirmishers and Kellermann, and put the jäger battalion into Blasowitz. constantine.role (claimed attributed on these) says the disposition posts it behind Blasowitz and Kruh; PLANS.al.cols[7].ord 'remain behind Krzenowitz, in hand' and ANALYSIS[#plan] 'stands in reserve behind Krzenowitz' are unchecked. Step 4's proposal C6.p12 changed the role text only ('Text only').
findings.expected: Positions graded A agree with the A-graded readings the project holds, or are regraded; plan text agrees with the disposition as read; a capture event's named defender is drawn near the place.
findings.observed: Two A grades and their carried A (rg_inf@5) contradict the register; plan order and theme contradict the role.
findings.remedy: Data task with the source agents: re-plot rg_inf/rg_cav 07:00-11:00 onto the Blasowitz-Krug heights or regrade to B/C with a note; reword PLANS.al.cols[7].ord and ANALYSIS[#plan] to the disposition; give the Blasowitz event a written tolerance reason or the Guard a nearby anchor.
findings.cause_hypothesis: Step 4 corrected the role from the readings but not the positions or the plan.
findings.risk: Moves the plateau reading (rg_inf/rg_cav enter the outline), motion baselines, sim-test event agreement.
findings.validation: blasowitz-guard probe; sim-test event agreement; check:chronology.
findings.dependencies: Source agents' reading of the Guard's route

findings.title: 44 of 88 A grades are carried forward from earlier anchors, against the grading rule 8K applied to Suchet
findings.subsystem: data: track grades (cf carried by stateAt) and their display (POS_CLAIM, CONF_TEXT, confidence outline)
findings.user_impact: Pursuits and retreats 1-2.7 km past the last documented anchor show 'Position: documented' / 'Position documented in the sources' (e.g. Caffarelli 11:15-17:00, Kellermann and Nansouty's pursuit, Liechtenstein's and the Russian Guard's retreats, Kienmayer and Dokhturov on the ice), while Suchet's neighbouring pursuit anchors at the same hours were set to C in 8K because 'no reading places' them.
findings.evidence: grades.txt: 180 positioned anchors, 88 graded A, 90 grades carried forward, 44 of them A; e.g. caffarelli@6-@9 A from @5 (moved 0.79-1.45 km each, no act), lich@6-@9, rg_inf@7-@9, rg_cav@7-@9, kellermann@6/7/9, nansouty@6/7/9. 8K register: 'B where a reading places the formation at that time relative to a named place; C where no reading places it then ... No grade was kept because it was there'; Suchet @6-@8 'B (inherited) to C for all three'; 'Caffarelli's anchors (not on the road, not re-plotted)'.
findings.expected: One grading rule across the dataset; a carried-forward grade reassessed where the formation has moved.
findings.observed: The rule was applied to the twelve 8K anchors only.
findings.remedy: Data task: review each carried-forward A (list in grades.txt) against the readings and declare its grade; optionally a test.js rule requiring a declared cf on any anchor that moves more than a set distance.
findings.cause_hypothesis: stateAt carries cf forward by design (data.js header); never revisited.
findings.risk: Confidence outlines and check:visual confidence shares change.
findings.validation: grades.js: no A carried past a move without review.

findings.title: Three events whose own texts say the hour is disputed are not labelled disputed
findings.user_impact: 'Napoleon releases Soult' and 'The Russian Guard takes the eagle' show 'Estimate' and the ice event 'Fact' with no 'hour disputed' on their labels, caption tags or dossier header, though their whys (or, for the ice, its phase line) say the hour is disputed.
findings.evidence: Probe in event-claims context: decision (est) 'The hour is disputed: about eight in Ségur...'; guard-attack (est) 'The hour is disputed: Rapp and Ségur put the Guard's last effort about 13:00, Schönhals has the fight over by about noon'; PHASES[8] line c. 15:00 'The accounts differ on the hour'. CLAIM.disputed's definition (data.js:20) fits each.
findings.expected: By CLAIM.disputed's definition and decision 201 (b)'s principle, an event whose accounts give different hours carries claim 'disputed' with a dispute text.
findings.remedy: Data task: claim 'disputed' with dispute texts for decision, guard-attack and ice; measure labels.
findings.cause_hypothesis: Decision 201 covered the seven events lowered by question 193 only.
findings.validation: No event why/phase line says 'disputed' while its claim is not.

findings.title: Kamensky's named conflict: the turn is drawn from 08:00, before the French climb, not 'in the 08:45 phase' as disclosed; it lifts the derived plateau reading
findings.subsystem: data/records: kamensky@2->@3 leg, SOURCE_NOTE open question, event dispute, arrow note
findings.user_impact: From 08:00 the brigade, shown 'On the march ... at the rear of Langeron's column', walks back north-east toward the Pratzeberg while Saint-Hilaire still waits in the valley; at 08:29 the caption's 'derived on the heights: Allied' rises 19,300 to 23,550 with no French on the plateau. The disclosures understate the drawn conflict by 45 minutes.
findings.evidence: named-conflicts.txt and plateau-day.txt: kamensky [259,316] at 08:00 to [268.8,298.4] at 08:44, heading 151 deg; enters PLATEAU_POLY at 08:29; sthilaire at [206,231] until 08:45. SOURCE_NOTE: 'in the 08:45 phase in his brigade's record'; the event dispute 'turns it in the 08:45 phase'; arrow interp 'the track in phase 3'. sim-test prints '08:45 Soult attacks on the heights: Allied 23550'.
findings.expected: The disclosure names what is drawn (from 08:00), or the leg holds until 08:45 (the act's own sequence: he turns on seeing the French).
findings.observed: Leg window 08:00-08:45 by the default rule.
findings.remedy: Record fix (SOURCE_NOTE, event dispute, arrow note: 'from 08:00') or, under decision 42, a moveMin hold on kamensky@3 so the turn starts at 08:45; owner to choose.
findings.cause_hypothesis: Default leg window from kamensky@2's arrival.
findings.risk: check:chronology verdict text and the plateau reading's recorded figures.

findings.title: Kienmayer 'Holding west of the Goldbach' is drawn 0.9 km east of the brook (since Stage 0)
findings.user_impact: From 12:45 Kienmayer's dossier says 'Holding west of the Goldbach as the trap closes behind it' while its block stands 901 m east of the drawn stream; its marker never crosses the stream all day.
findings.evidence: legs-water.txt: kienmayer@7 [242,400] east 901 m; @1 east 714 m, @2 east 265 m. Stage 0's build has the same anchor and act with the brook at x 212 there; 8J's records file it as an 'offset from the corrected brook' although the brook south of y 377.9 was not changed.
findings.expected: An act's side of the stream agrees with its anchor.
findings.observed: Contradiction since Stage 0; misattributed in 8J's record.
findings.remedy: Data task: reword the act (e.g. 'Holding east of the Goldbach before Telnitz') or re-plot with evidence; correct the 8J record.
findings.cause_hypothesis: Original text never checked against the drawn brook.

findings.title: Caffarelli's objective 'Push Bagration off the highway' shown 12:45-17:00 while 1.5-2.2 km from the highway and moving away; separation misstated in records
findings.user_impact: The dossier's objective and the phase-5 narrative (Bagration broken by Caffarelli's, Suchet's and d'Hautpoul's attacks) do not match the drawn route east toward Krzenowitz, graded 'Position: documented'.
findings.evidence: caffarelli-bagration.txt: 12:45-17:00 to the highway 1.54-2.15 km, to Bagration 1.61-2.64 km, nearest enemy Liechtenstein; objective carried from @7; cf A from @5. Records say 2.5-2.9 km; measured 2.13 km at 14:30 and 2.64 km at 17:00 (true distance and northing alike).
findings.expected: Objective and route agree, or the act says the route is this map's; records quote measured figures.
findings.observed: Unexplained separation, A grade, records' numbers 0.3-0.4 km high.
findings.remedy: Data task with the source agents (Caffarelli's afternoon route); correct the 8K/CHANGELOG figure.

findings.title: Interpolated legs pass through enemies and across the Litava; the movement audit tests neither
findings.user_impact: Bourcier's dragoons are drawn running through Kienmayer (26 m at 14:38) and Dokhturov (12 m at 14:54) to reach Augezd ahead of the retreating columns; Miloradovich's 14:30 anchor stands on the Litava (19 m from its line, covWater 0.96) and its legs cross the river twice with no road.

findings.expected: No opposing blocks drawn in one another outside a melee; no river crossing without a road or a recorded crossing.
findings.remedy: Data task (Bourcier via points behind the columns or later; milo@8 off the river); add proximity and river-crossing rules to audit.js/sim-test.js.
findings.cause_hypothesis: Routes drawn by hand on a schematic road/river.

findings.title: Sokolnitz village drawn empty 09:00-13:15 although the texts have it taken and retaken and defended by Legrand, then Friant
findings.subsystem: data: legrand, friant, lang tracks; FEATURES sokolnitz
findings.user_impact: After Legrand's marker leaves at 08:00 no formation of either side is nearer the village than the III Column at the castle (0.79 km); Friant is never drawn there; Langeron 'storms Sokolnitz' (graded A) from 0.98 km across the brook. The II Column arrow says 'the model has the column at the village from 08:00'.
findings.evidence: sokolnitz-defence.txt: 09:00-13:00 nearest French friant 0.83-1.21 km, nearest Allied prz 0.79 km; lang@2 [235,350] 976 m from [208,365], 452 m east of the brook (legs-water.txt).
findings.expected: The village fight the narrative describes has formations drawn at it, or the texts say the markers are division centres far from it.
findings.remedy: Data task with source agents (who held the village; Legrand's brigade-only move; lang@2's grade); correct the arrow note.
findings.cause_hypothesis: One marker per division; Legrand's marker used for Levasseur's brigade.

findings.title: Command tab: DOCUMENTED on 31 rows the claims register calls 'Not yet checked'; a phase-5 row anticipates Blasowitz's fall; a 'Could see' row holds a historiographical dispute
findings.user_impact: One statement is 'DOCUMENTED' in the Command tab and 'Not yet checked' in the sources sheet's index; from 10:30 the Allied reading says it 'knew ... that Blasowitz had fallen' (the map's fall is 11:15); 'Could see: The accounts differ on who turned Kamensky's brigade about'.
findings.evidence: command-claims.txt: 35 DOCUMENTED rows, 31 unchecked; paintCommand shows book[curPhase] for the whole phase; KIND saw -> 'Could see'. No claimTag in the Command tab.
findings.expected: One label per statement across screens; rows timed within their phase; row kinds that fit their content.
findings.remedy: Presentation: the claim tag in the Command tab (or DOCUMENTED only where the claim is attributed/disputed); data: move al@5's Blasowitz row to phase 6, change al@4[0]'s kind.
findings.risk: check:contrast states with the Command tab.

findings.title: Dossier says 'Marching' beside 'In reserve'/'Concealed' on 63 slow drift legs

findings.title: Smaller internal inconsistencies in texts and fields
findings.evidence: (a) sthilaire@2/vandamme@2 'Crosses the Goldbach' in phase 2 while 146 m/265 m west of the drawn stream (legs-water.txt). (b) ahq@4 'orders Kamensky to retire' at 09:30-10:30 vs kamensky@5 fighting and @6 'ordered to retire by Kutuzov' at 11:15. (c) 'Arm: Guard infantry' for both Guard corps (c_gd, constantine include cavalry): app.js:7970 maps guard to 'Guard infantry'. (d) G-3 still open: milo@0 A 'near Pratzen village' 1.6 km from it. (e) Unaccented 'Chasseurs a Pied/a Cheval', 'Garde Imperiale', 'Reserve de Cavalerie', 'emigre', 'Frederic Walther' (outside decision 209's six names); guard_inf.commander holds a composition. (f) data.js header gives the frame as ~13 x ~10 km; KM_PER_MAP gives 21.5 x 15.8 km (comment only). (g) Langeron's counter 11,700 includes Kamensky's 4,250, drawn separately from 08:00, with no 'including' in its note; Buxhowden's card/counter '≈ 40,000' without its '33,000-40,000' range. (h) The Chevalier Guard (800 of rg_cav's 2,900) drawn with the Guard from 04:00 at A though the data has it come up late in Maliutin's column.
findings.expected: Texts, fields and labels agree with positions and with each other.
findings.remedy: One small data task for (a), (b), (d), (e), (f), (g) notes; presentation for (c) ('Guard' for corps); (h) with the source agents.
